hooks.command: [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS:-}" ] && [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT:-}" ] || echo '{"systemMessage": "google-analytics has no settings yet, so its MCP server cannot start. Since 2.0.0 it no longer reads GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT from your shell. Run /plugin configure google-analytics@wookstar-claude-plugins (or claude plugin configure google-analytics@wookstar-claude-plugins in a terminal), then restart Claude Code."}'
